26/* @brief Per-link inertia data in the link's body frame.
27 *
28 * Constant in the joint configuration q -- build once at controller initialization with
29 * @ref BuildArticulatedLinkInertias and reuse across calls. */
30struct ArticulatedLinkInertia {
31 /* Total link mass [kg]. */
32 real mass = 0_r;
33 /* Center of mass in the link's body frame [m]. */
34 Real3 comLocal = {};
35 /* 3x3 moment of inertia about the COM, in the link's body frame [kg.m^2].
36 * Symmetric. Standard convention: diagonals are integral(y^2 + z^2)dm etc., off-diagonals are
37 * negative products of inertia (-integral(xy)dm etc.). Matches URDF / Featherstone. */
38 Matrix3x3r inertiaCom = {};
39};

41/* @brief Build per-link inertia data for an articulated actor.
42 *
43 * Walks @ref Actor::GetNestedLinkActors and reads mass, COM, and the 3x3 inertia tensor at COM
44 * from each link. The resulting data is constant in q -- intended to be cached at controller
45 * initialization, not recomputed per step.
46 *
47 * @param[in] articulatedActor Articulated actor to introspect (non-null,
48 * ActorType::Articulated).
49 * @param[out] outLinkInertias Cleared and populated with one entry per nested link.
50 * @param[in,out] error Error status. */
51MOCHI_API void BuildArticulatedLinkInertias(
52 Actor* articulatedActor,
53 DynamicArray<ArticulatedLinkInertia>& outLinkInertias,
54 superdex::Error& error);

56/* @brief Compute the joint-space mass matrix M(q) for an articulated actor.
57 *
58 * @details Uses the kinetic-energy form of CRBA:
59 *
60 * M(q) = sum over links i of J_i^T * G_i^world * J_i
61 *
62 * where J_i is link i's 6 x numDofs spatial Jacobian (world frame, [linear; angular] row layout),
63 * and G_i^world is the 6x6 spatial inertia of link i taken AT ITS COM expressed in world frame:
64 *
65 * G_i^world = [ m_i * I_3 0 ]
66 * [ 0 R_i * I_C * R_i^T ]
67 *
68 * with R_i = world rotation of link i and I_C = 3x3 inertia tensor about COM in link's body frame.
69 *
70 * Mochi's per-link Jacobian gives the linear velocity AT THE LINK'S COM, so the spatial inertia
71 * must also be taken at the COM -- the off-diagonal blocks are zero and there is no parallel-axis
72 * term. This holds structurally, not just empirically: @c CreateRestTransforms
73 * (mochi_core/src/articulated_body/articulated_body.cpp) bakes each link's @c comLocal into the
74 * rest transforms, so the articulation's internal "bone" frame that the Jacobian differentiates is
75 * COM-centered (see the @c ArticulatedRestTransform docs, which describe it as the center-of-mass
76 * frame). Mochi relies on the same property itself, computing joint-space gravity as
77 * sum(J_linear^T * m_i * g) in @ref experimental::GetNewtonEulerTerms.
78 *
79 * The per-link Jacobian is fetched inside the loop via @ref Actor::GetArticulatedJacobian on each
80 * nested link actor (no public accessor returns the full stacked body Jacobian).
81 *
82 * @param[in] articulatedActor Articulated actor whose nested link actors expose per-link
83 * Jacobians via @ref Actor::GetArticulatedJacobian. Must be the
84 * same actor used to build @p linkInertias and produce
85 * @p worldFromLinks.
86 * @param[in] linkInertias Per-link inertia data from @ref BuildArticulatedLinkInertias.
87 * Must contain numLinks entries.
88 * @param[in] worldFromLinks Per-link world transforms (size numLinks) from
89 * @ref Actor::GetArticulatedLinkTransforms. These are link-ORIGIN
90 * transforms, which differ from the COM frame the Jacobian uses by
91 * R * comLocal. Only their rotation is read, and the two frames
92 * share it, so no conversion is needed or wanted here.
93 * @param[in] numDofs Total articulated DOF count. M will be numDofs x numDofs.
94 * @param[out] outM Row-major numDofs x numDofs mass matrix (size numDofs * numDofs).
95 * Symmetric and positive-definite for non-degenerate inertias.
96 * @param[in,out] error Error status.
97 *
98 * @note Rigid-body inertia only. A joint's @ref ArticulatedJointParams::inertia (rotor/armature)
99 * is stored separately and added to the diagonal by the solver, so it is absent from M here; add
100 * it yourself if you need the diagonal the solver actually sees. */
101MOCHI_API void ComputeArticulatedMassMatrix(
102 Actor* articulatedActor,
103 Span<ArticulatedLinkInertia const> linkInertias,
104 Span<TransformRT const> worldFromLinks,
105 int numDofs,
106 Span<real> outM,
107 superdex::Error& error);
108
